newWorld.title: NEW WORLD
newWorld.seed.description: Sets the deterministic seed used to generate the world. Use Random Seed for a new value.
newWorld.spawnBiome.description: Forces the player to spawn in the selected biome.
pause.title: PAUSED
settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.gameMode.description: Controls the player's abilities and survival rules for the current world.
settings.ticksBySecond.description: Controls how many simulation ticks the world advances per real second.
settings.renderDistance.description: Controls how far terrain is generated and rendered around the player.
settings.language.description: Controls the language used by menus and interface text.
settings.displayTooltips.description: Enables or disables contextual gameplay hints displayed on the HUD.
settings.targetBlockPosition.description: Controls where information about the targeted block is displayed on the HUD.
hud.breakOrPlaceBlock: Left click to break block, or right click to place.
hud.openInventory: Press E to open inventory, or ESC to pause game.
hud.closeInventory: Press E or ESC to close inventory.
hud.brushPaint: Left click to paint {color}. Right click to choose color.
hud.brushClear: Left click to clear. Right click to choose color.
brush.palette.title: Brush
